scope: Stormveil Liftside Chamber, Limgrave Tower Bridge, broken bridge sending gate and Divine Tower of Limgrave
method: Online source cross-check. Claims are paraphrased; no game process, save, archive, tile or private API was accessed.

claims.claim: The Stormveil courtyard route reaches the Limgrave Tower Bridge grace; the bridge route is distinct from the northern Lake-Facing Cliffs exit.

The bridge is broken; after the golems, a sending gate transports the player to the tower base, where an internal lift reaches the Divine Tower grace. The tower door requires Godrick's Great Rune state.
